meta.count_semantics: incident_count is retained for backward compatibility and equals article_mention_count. Neither field is a confirmed incident count.

method.association: region and drone terms are counted only within a ±700-character window around the actor mention

meta.caveat: Heuristic public-source mention analysis. Co-mentions, quotations, syndicated reporting, and ambiguous acronyms can still produce false positives. Use these fingerprints as a triage and similarity prior, not as ground-truth attribution or an operational incident ledger.
meta.temporal_semantics: Source coverage and actor first/last-seen fields exclude article dates later than the pipeline time plus the stated tolerance. Excluded rows remain in the corpus but do not extend temporal ranges.
